create_bsuite_environment_subclass: create a python class that subclasses bsuite Environment and implements _step _reset and bsuite_info
implement_environment_reset: implement the _reset method in a bsuite Environment subclass to return an initial dm_env TimeStep
implement_environment_step: implement the _step method in a bsuite Environment subclass to process an action and return a TimeStep
implement_bsuite_info: implement the bsuite_info method to return a dictionary of metadata for logging and scoring
set_bsuite_num_episodes: set the bsuite_num_episodes class attribute to define how many episodes the environment should run for
